question.text: Under the SEBI SAST Regulations, within how many working days from the date of the detailed public statement must the draft letter of offer be filed with SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the merchant banker must file the draft letter of offer with SEBI within 5 working days from the date of the detailed public statement (DPS). SEBI then has up to 15 working days from receipt of the draft letter of offer to provide its comments, and the tendering period commences within 12 working days of receiving SEBI's comments. The Trap: "15 working days" is the time SEBI has to comment on the draft letter of offer, not the deadline for filing it. These two distinct timelines are commonly confused. Note: Source - NISM-Series-IX Merchant Banking Certification Examination workbook (Jan 2026), pp. 207-208 and 213.
